description: This file manages shared key-value entries within the Superset project, including retrieving, setting, migrating legacy entries, and generating salts for shared keys.

methods.name: get_shared_value
methods.description: Retrieves a shared value by key, attempting fallback algorithms for legacy entries and migrating them to the current algorithm if found.

methods.name: set_shared_value
methods.description: Sets a shared value for a given key using the current hash algorithm, creating a new entry.

methods.name: get_permalink_salt
methods.description: Retrieves or generates a salt value associated with a shared key, creating a new salt if none exists.
